findings.message: Root composition is missing `data-composition-id`.
findings.fixHint: Add a stable `data-composition-id` to the entry composition wrapper.

findings.message: Root composition is missing `data-width` or `data-height`.
findings.fixHint: Set numeric `data-width` and `data-height` on the entry composition root.

findings.message: ".inner" has CSS `transform: translateX(-50%)` and a GSAP tween animates y/scale. GSAP will overwrite the full CSS transform, discarding any translateX(-50%) centering or CSS scale value.
findings.fixHint: Remove `transform: translateX(-50%)` from CSS and replace with GSAP properties: xPercent: -50. Example: tl.fromTo('.inner', { xPercent: -50 }, { xPercent: -50, ...yourAnimation }). tl.fromTo is exempt from this rule.

findings.message: Caption exit animations (tl.to with opacity: 0) detected without a hard tl.set kill. Exit tweens can fail when karaoke word-level tweens conflict, leaving captions stuck on screen.
findings.fixHint: Add `tl.set(groupEl, { opacity: 0, visibility: "hidden" }, group.end)` after every exit tl.to animation as a deterministic kill.

findings.message: Track 0 has 9 timed elements in this HTML file. Smaller sub-compositions keep timelines easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Move coherent scene groups into separate .html files under compositions/ and mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so the timeline stays easier to inspect, revise, and validate.

findings.fixHint: Add class="clip" to the element so Studio and the linter can recognise it as a clip.
